ja428:1.1: Puthusaddo samajano, na bālo koci maññatha, (= Vinaya vol.I. p..) saṃghasmiṃ bhijjamānasmiṃ nāññaṃ bhiyyo amaññaruṃ.
ja428:2.1: Parimuṭṭhā paṇḍitābhāsā vācāgocara bhāṇino yāv' icchanti mukhāyāmaṃ yena nītā na taṃ vidū.
ja428:3.1: ‘Akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ ajini maṃ ahāsi me' (Cfr. supra p..) ye taṃ upanayhanti veraṃ tesaṃ na sammati.
ja428:4.1: ‘Akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ ajini maṃ ahāsi me' ye taṃ na upanayhanti veraṃ tesūpasammati.
ja428:5.1: Na hi verena verāni sammant' idha kudācanaṃ, averena ca sammanti, esa dhammo sanantano.
ja428:6.1: Pare ca na vijānanti 'mayam ettha yamāmase', ye ca tattha vijānanti tato sammanti medhagā.
ja428:7.1: Aṭṭhicchiddā pāṇaharā gavāssadhanahārino, raṭṭhaṃ vilumpamānānaṃ tesaṃ pi hoti saṃgati, kasmā tumhāka no siyā.
ja428:8.1: Sace labetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ (Cfr. Dhp. vv.328-30 & p.. Suttanip. VV. - 45.) saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāri dhīraṃ abhibhuyya sabbāni parissayāni careyya ten' attamano satīmā.
ja428:9.1: No ce labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāri dhīraṃ rājā va raṭṭhaṃ vijitaṃ pahāya eko care mātaṅg' araññe va nāgo.
ja428:10.1: Ekassa caritaṃ seyyo, n' atthi bāle sahāyatā, eko care na ca pāpāni kayirā appossukko mātaṅg' araññe va nāgo ti.
